privacy.delete.body: A teacher can delete a student or a class on the class page — it is deleted at once and for good, and a deleted student's points leave the rankings. Deleting the account in Settings → Profile deletes all of the teacher's classes, students and games too. A parent can ask the teacher to delete their child's data.
privacy.delete.title: How to delete it
privacy.google.body: When a teacher signs in with Google, Google sends Elifba the teacher's name and e-mail address. When the account is created, this name and address are written to it (the teacher can change the name). Apart from that, Elifba keeps only the Google account's number, to recognise the teacher next time. No picture or other information is kept. Nothing about the children is ever sent to Google. Signing in with Google is the teacher's choice: signing up with an e-mail address and a password works too.
privacy.google.title: Signing in with Google
privacy.how_long.body: Classes and students are kept until the teacher deletes them. Archived classes and students are deleted automatically after :days days, and games older than :days days are deleted with their points.

privacy.intro: Elifba helps teachers run reading games in class. Children never use the app themselves and have no accounts. Only what the games need to work is stored.
privacy.not_stored.body: No child's surname, patronymic, photo, birth date, gender, address, phone number or ID number is stored. When a teacher pastes a list of names, surnames are read only to suggest the first names and are kept nowhere. Children never log in and are never asked for anything.

privacy.operator.unknown: The operator of this instance has not published contact details. If you have questions, ask whoever gave you this address, or your school.
privacy.parents.description: Before you use Elifba with your class, you can copy this text and send it to parents.
privacy.parents.note:
Dear parents,

In our lessons we will use Elifba reading games to help the children learn to read. The children play on the classroom board; they never log in to the app or type anything into it.

For each child, Elifba keeps only a first name (with a surname initial when needed) and an animal avatar. No surname, photo or contact details are stored. Game points are only for encouragement within the class.

The data is deleted automatically after :days days, and you can ask me at any time to delete your child's data sooner. We use Elifba with the school's permission.

If you have any questions, please write to me.
privacy.parents.selected: The text is selected — press Ctrl+C (⌘+C on a Mac) to copy it.
privacy.parents.title: A note for parents
privacy.stored.body:
Teacher: name, email address, a hash of the password and the interface language.
Class: the teacher's name for it (for example “1A”), its grade and the letters it has learned.
Student: a first name only (with a surname initial when two children share a name), an animal avatar and their place in the class order.
Games: which game was played when, which student solved which round, and the points they earned.

privacy.title: Privacy note
privacy.where.body: Everything is kept on this Elifba instance's own server. Its pages make no requests to outside services: no ads, analytics, web fonts or trackers.

privacy.why.body: Names and avatars show whose turn it is at the board; points make the class's daily and weekly rankings. The data is not used for advertising, analytics or anything else, and is given to no one.
